title: Dashboard local storage route hardening
description: Harden the local dashboard storage route for content type, binary data, missing object errors, local-mode guardrails, and path validation while preserving Amplify Storage compatibility.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Starting fix for TS2345 in dashboard/app/api/local-storage/route.ts where Uint8Array is rejected by Response body typing during ci:typecheck. Plan: inspect current implementation, apply minimal type-safe body conversion, rerun dashboard typecheck, and record verification output.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implemented fix in dashboard/app/api/local-storage/route.ts: normalized GET payload to a fresh Uint8Array before constructing Response to satisfy BodyInit typing. Verification: from dashboard/, ran npm run ci:typecheck (tsc --noEmit --pretty --diagnostics), completed successfully with no TS errors; total check time ~175.84s.
